name: Michael Keating
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Denver, Colorado

about: Serving clients across Colorado, Michael Keating provides dedicated counsel in matters of personal injury, including motor vehicle accidents, wrongful death, brain injury, trucking accidents, premises liability and motor vehicle defects. Practicing at Keating Wagner Polidori Free in Denver, Colorado, he has worked as a trial lawyer for over two decades. He approaches each case with empathy, compassion and dedication to achieve suitable compensation for his clients.

Graduating from Indiana University with a bachelor's degree in English and history, Mr. Keating pursued his law degree at the University of Denver Sturm College of Law. Upon earning his Juris Doctor in 2001, he gained admission to practice law in Colorado the same year. Prior to transitioning to his current practice in personal injury law, he served as a deputy district attorney in Adams County. This experience provided him with insight into the workings of the justice system before he joined his current firm.

Throughout his career, Mr. Keating has strived to ensure his clients have access to justice and they receive the compensation they deserve. His continuous efforts have helped various clients obtain justice and an opportunity to secure their future. With a primary focus on serious personal injury, fire and explosion injuries and product liability, he is accountable for some of Colorado's largest personal injury verdicts. He has successfully represented his clients against businesses like Toyota, Ford Motor Corporation, Kroger and Qwest (now CenturyLink).

As a member of the Colorado Bar Association, the Denver Bar Association and the Colorado Trial Lawyers Association, Mr. Keating maintains an active standing in the legal community. Additionally, he served as the co-chairperson of the Products Liability Subcommittee of the Colorado Trial Lawyers Association. He has gained numerous accolades for his commitment and professionalism, including Best Lawyers in America for Medical Malpractice Law, Personal Injury Litigation and Product Liability Litigation in 2022.
